### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** __HEAD__
* **Context Scope:** plugins/dso/scripts/skip-review-check.sh, plugins/dso/hooks/compute-diff-hash.sh, plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-allowlist.conf, plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The DSO review gate is intended to cover LLM-instruction artifacts (skills, prompts, agents, CLAUDE.md, hooks) but EXEMPT non-LLM-instruction documents from full code review. The set of non-reviewable document directories should be configurable per host project via .claude/dso-config.conf so a consuming project whose prose docs live outside the shipped docs/** exemption can declare them without editing plugin-shipped files.

#### Actual Behavior

The non-reviewable file classification is hardcoded in the plugin-shipped review-gate-allowlist.conf (consumed by skip-review-check.sh and compute-diff-hash.sh). It exempts docs/**, .claude/docs/**, .claude/session-logs/**, .claude/artifacts/** but provides NO dso-config.conf key for a host project to add its own non-LLM-instruction doc directories. A host whose docs live elsewhere (e.g., documentation/, adr/, wiki/) gets the full review process on minor Markdown edits. The only override seams are ALLOWLIST_OVERRIDE / CONF_OVERRIDE env vars, which exist for TEST ISOLATION. A host project worked around this by abusing those env vars and adding a blanket *.md exemption -- which is unsafe because skills/agents/prompts ARE markdown and would be silently exempted from the review meant to cover them.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Reported by a host project running an older released DSO. Need to determine whether current DSO addresses configurability (it exempts docs/** but exposes no config key).
data.title: review-gate: non-LLM-instruction doc dirs outside docs/** -> full review enforced; no dso-config hook
